summary: First-run backend+frontend test for Imagen Studio. Backend: 18/18 pytest tests pass covering meta, generate, references, presets (CRUD + analyze), gallery (list/delete), bulk (start->poll->completed->zip), settings (get/update/clear/regenerate MCP token), and MCP transport (401 without auth, initialize handshake, tools/list returns exactly the 6 expected tools, tools/call list_gallery returns absolute https URLs). Frontend: Studio, Bulk, Gallery (with lightbox + all 5 action buttons), Presets (dialog opens with all fields), Settings (MCP URL ends with /api/mcp, token is 44 chars) all load correctly. Bulk end-to-end flow completed with ZIP button clickable.
critical_code_review_comments: bulk-item-status-{i} data-testid appears only during pending/generating states; once the item reaches 'done' the status label is replaced by an icon-only variant, so the testid vanishes from the DOM. Consider keeping the testid on the status container in all states so automated tests can assert 'done'.
MCPAuthMiddleware reads token from DB on every request via service.get_mcp_token(); consider caching after first read to avoid an extra DB roundtrip per MCP call (low priority).
GET /api/settings response is unauthenticated and exposes the current mcp_token in plaintext; acceptable for MVP behind ingress but note that anyone hitting /api/settings can retrieve the MCP token.
test_credentials: None needed — EMERGENT_LLM_KEY already configured in /app/backend/.env
seed_data_creation: Generated test images, references, style presets, and bulk batches under TEST_ prefixed names. Test-created presets are deleted; generated images may remain in the gallery.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py. MCP tests must POST to /api/mcp/ (trailing slash) with Authorization: Bearer <token> and Accept: application/json, text/event-stream. tools/list/tools/call responses come back as SSE (text/event-stream) — parse the 'data:' line to extract the JSON-RPC payload. Bulk batches take ~60-120s to complete; poll with generous timeouts. The presets-dialog-description data-testid renders only after a reference is uploaded/analyzed (conditional field), which is expected. The bulk-item-status-{i} testid disappears when an item completes — currently tests must poll backend or wait for the ZIP button.
